subject.title: [Feature]: WebUI notification system, cron job management popups, and context monitor integration

question: Should OpenClaw define a core connected-Control-UI in-app notification/action queue for cron results and context pressure, and how should it share contracts with Web Push, admin notify, and WebChat actions?
rationale: Source inspection shows partial pieces but no central toast/action queue or snooze semantics, and the remaining shape crosses product architecture rather than a single mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Define shared notification/action contract first
options.body: Create one in-app queue and typed action model, then wire cron completion and context pressure into that surface.

options.title: Split into narrower canonical issues
options.body: Keep this issue as UX requirements while routing implementation through #53228, #46656, and #40644 as the canonical architecture trackers.

options.title: Defer core toast and snooze work
options.body: Keep the current inline context ring, cron list/history, and Web Push settings if maintainers do not want a core in-app notification layer yet.

recommendation.title: Define shared notification/action contract first
recommendation.body: Create one in-app queue and typed action model, then wire cron completion and context pressure into that surface.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger has the broadest recent current-main signal across the affected cron, notification, and context UI surfaces.
